html:
Join Vietlook Travel on a memorable island adventure in Nha Trang Bay. This tour offers the perfect combination of snorkeling at Mun Island, experiencing local life at a floating fishing village, and enjoying a premium mud bath and hydrotherapy experience at Hon Tam Island. It is an ideal choice for travelers who love the sea, nature, and relaxation.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

08:45
Board a speed canoe and begin visiting the islands.

MUN ISLAND

09:15
Arrive at Mun Island, one of the best snorkeling spots in Nha Trang.

Free time to swim, snorkel, and admire colorful coral reefs.

Swimming goggles and snorkels are provided free of charge.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as jet ski, parasailing, scuba diving, sea walking, banana boat, and more.

FISHING VILLAGE

11:30
Visit a floating fishing village and have lunch at a raft restaurant (lunch included in the tour).

The restaurant is built on wooden rafts and features live tanks and nets filled with fish, lobsters, crabs, and mussels (seafood selection may incur additional charges).

After lunch, free time to rest and relax.

HON TAM ISLAND

12:30
Arrive at Hon Tam Island and enjoy a premium relaxation experience.

Guests can use the mud bath service package and full-body hydrotherapy massage system, including free use of towels and bathing suits.

Free time to take photos, swim, and relax at the 2,400 m² swimming pool overlooking the beautiful Nha Trang Bay.

15:30 – 16:00
Return to the mainland by canoe. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 32

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch at the island (floating raft restaurant)

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance tickets

  • Bottled water

  • Snorkeling mask and goggles

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional water activities outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
